description: Coral photosynthesis–irradiance presets for the Coral Shading Protocol. Ek in µmol photons m-2 s-1 (PAR).

model.equation: P_gross(E) = Pmax * tanh(E / Ek)  (Jassby & Platt 1976); P_net = P_gross - R
model.photoacclimation: Optional: Ek_acclimated = (Ek/Emax of the source) x peak daily irradiance at the coral (Falkowski & Dubinsky 1981; Anthony & Hoegh-Guldberg 2003; Sawall & Hochberg 2018)

presets.label: Typical shallow coral (default)
presets.Ek_basis: Median (interquartile range) of 26 published in situ or field-fresh coral P–E curves from 1–12 m compiled by Sawall & Hochberg (2018)
presets.R_over_Pg_basis: Middle of the same-study ratios below (0.25–0.41)
presets.Ek_Emax_basis: Median Ek/Emax of the same 26 curves (Sawall & Hochberg 2018, S1 Table column Ek/Emax)

presets.label: Stylophora pistillata
presets.Ek_basis: Light-adapted colonies, 2 m, Eilat (Porter et al. 1984); 5 m winter 121 and summer 233 (Mass et al. 2007), as compiled by Sawall & Hochberg (2018)
presets.notes: Mass et al. (2007) give Ek values of 1084.5 (summer) and 659.5 (winter) µmol m-2 s-1 at 5 m in their text; Sawall & Hochberg (2018) list these as the maximum irradiance and give Ek 233 and 121. The preset uses Porter et al. (1984).

presets.label: Pocillopora verrucosa
presets.Ek_basis: Mean (range) of 12 curves, 5 m, six Red Sea sites in summer and winter (Sawall et al. 2014), as compiled by Sawall & Hochberg (2018)

presets.label: Pocillopora damicornis
presets.Ek_basis: 3 m, Kāneʻohe Bay, Hawaiʻi, gross photosynthesis (Davies 1991), as compiled by Sawall & Hochberg (2018)
presets.R_over_Pg_basis: Lesser et al. (1994), 1.5 m, Kāneʻohe Bay, three water-motion levels: R/Pg = 0.95/2.6, 1.8/5.7, 3.6/9.1 (Coral Trait Database)

presets.label: Porites lobata
presets.Ek_basis: 3 m, Kāneʻohe Bay, Hawaiʻi, gross photosynthesis (Davies 1991), as compiled by Sawall & Hochberg (2018)

presets.label: Acropora cervicornis
presets.Ek_basis: 12 m, Bahamas, gross photosynthesis (Chalker 1981), as compiled by Sawall & Hochberg (2018)
presets.R_over_Pg_basis: Porter (1980), 10 m fore reef, Jamaica: R 0.38, Pg 1.31 µmol O2 cm-2 h-1 (Coral Trait Database); 1 m back reef, St. Croix gives 0.41 (Gladfelter et al. 1989)

presets.label: Porites cylindrica
presets.Ek_basis: Nubbins kept 71 days at the collection site (semi-protected reef flat, northwestern Philippines); hyperbolic-tangent fit (Chalker et al. 1983) per surface area at 28 °C, curves measured to about 1400 µmol m-2 s-1. Range: nubbins kept 77 days in laboratory aquaria at high and low water motion (maximum light 1000–1400 µmol m-2 s-1). Montebon & Yap (1995), Table 2.
presets.R_over_Pg_basis: Same curves, field controls: R 0.90 / Pmax 4.78 per area (0.19 also per chlorophyll a and per protein); Montebon & Yap (1995), Table 2.
presets.notes: High-light reef-flat corals. Ek lies near the top of the measured light range, so it is loosely constrained. The growth light of the field controls was not reported, so Ek is used as measured (no photoacclimation). Use with care.

excluded.reason: P–E curves exist (Gomez-Campo et al. 2024, Mol Ecol 33:e17246; 2–3 m, Mexican Caribbean), but Ek is not reported: Pmax and the initial slope are shown only as box plots (Fig. 1) and the data are said to be in Appendix S1, not obtained. The ratio of the upper-surface medians gives Ek ≈ 390 µmol m-2 s-1 (box limits 290–590), too uncertain for a preset. Gross photosynthesis and respiration without Ek in Bythell (1988) and Gladfelter et al. (1989).
No oxygen P–E curve with Ek found.
Only respiration–temperature data found (no P–E curve).

The only curve (Chalker 1981, 6 m, Magnetic Island, as compiled by Sawall & Hochberg 2018) gives Ek 55 with Ek/Emax 0.07, far below other shallow corals (0.2–0.5); under any shading it makes the coral look light-saturated nearly all day. Not checked against the original (closed access). Removed from the presets on 8 Nov 2026; restore if the original confirms it.

former_preset.label: Acropora muricata (formosa)
former_preset.Ek_basis: 6 m, Magnetic Island (turbid inshore GBR), gross photosynthesis (Chalker 1981, as A. formosa), as compiled by Sawall & Hochberg (2018)
former_preset.notes: Unusually low Ek for a shallow Acropora (Ek/Emax 0.07; most corals 0.2–0.5). Not checked against the original (closed access). Use with care.
